entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's such a delight to enjoy coffee[n]of this quality.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You could stay until you find a place,[n]you know. I can't promise it'd be[n]comfortable here though.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Thank you, but I'll return to the dorms.[n]I realized something after talking with[n]everyone last night.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps it's due to my upbringing, but[n]I don't know anything of the world,[n]let alone other people.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If I'm to depict people in my art, I need[n]to learn more about them; I must interact[n]with them more.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll return to the dorms... and start over[n]by talking with the people closest to me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I see. Good on you for realizing that[n]yourself.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There's no need to exaggerate. May I[n]come again sometime to enjoy your[n]coffee?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: My doors are always open.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: [fName]'s been through a lot too,[n]from what I've heard...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are you related to him?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Huh? Oh... How would I describe it...[n]We're just acquaintances. Not family[n]or anything.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I may be overstepping my bounds, but[n]why did you decide to take him in?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: My reason, huh...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Probably because... he reminds me[n]of my old self.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's all?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You know how it is. Sympathy makes you[n]do stupid things sometimes.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Your art instructor— Um, "former" art[n]instructor...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: He must've felt something for you too,[n]besides just stealing your talents.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Truth be told... I cannot hate him from[n]the depths of my heart either.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I should probably get going...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, you sure about this?[n]The painting, I mean.[n]It'd be a waste to keep here.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Even if I kept it at the dorms,[n]it'd only be met with skepticism.[n]I doubt it would want that.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Adding a hint of color to an[n]otherwise ordinary day... I'm sure[n]my mother would've done the same.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...I see. I'll hold on[n]to it for you then.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Thank you for the coffee.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I'll come again.
